NYC SUBWAY TIME MAP

This map represents the New York City subway in travel time. Each branch traces the fastest route from the selected origin to the terminus of a subway line and changes direction only at transfers. Stations not on these routes are omitted from the drawing but remain searchable.

Travel times are derived from the MTA GTFS subway schedule for weekdays between 2 and 4 PM: median running times between stations, waiting times of half the scheduled headway, and MTA’s minimum transfer times. Yellow adds extra time from the MTA Subway Customer Journey-Focused Metrics (last 12 months, off-peak, by line): the thick segment is the average additional platform and train time; the thin segment is a simulated bad day (90th percentile), assuming a 5–9-minute delay at each line’s rate of trips running 5+ minutes late. Station locations and complexes come from the MTA Subway Stations dataset; Staten Island is excluded.
